content.text: The
next step will be discussed next month. Until then, residents say they will keep watching closely and asking questions.
Early in the morning, before the sun was up, small crowds had already gathered. Many came on foot and others by bicycle, wanting to see for themselves what had been talked about for months.
What changed
Figures for the quarter show a rise of twelve per cent, the highest since records began in the area.

blocks.text: We did not wait for someone to do it for us. We started with what we had.

content.text: For many families the main thing is time. A journey of two hours now takes twenty minutes, and children reach school without being tired.
The project began last year
4,200 households benefit
The second phase starts in March
Not everyone is hopeful. Some residents say they were not consulted enough and want open meetings before the next stage begins.
